chapter: Jazz in Pass Christian and New Orleans
title: Yacht Club dances with Papa Celestin and New Orleans jazz today
summary: Sheila Hamill-Kerrigan, born 1940 in Pass Christian, recalls hearing Papa Celestin at Yacht Club dances as a child, and talks about French Quarter bands such as Al Hirt and the Celestin band still playing parties.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Okay. Well, I'm Sheila Hamer-Kerrigan, and I was born in 1940, and I live in Paschristian, Mississippi. And the first time I ever remember jazz, really, was, I guess, when I was that 9 or 10 down at the Yacht Club Dances. They used to have Papa Celestan come over from New Orleans all during the summer to play at the Yacht Club Dances. And... Yeah, mostly New Orleans people that were there at the Yacht Club? Yeah, mostly New Orleans people, of course, but, um, I don't know, all my friends like it. And it's, I think it's still popular in New Orleans, they say that, you know, rhythm and blues is really popular, but, I don't know, I like jazz much better.
